<!--
Piru only ships pharmacology it can trace to a source. To correct a value we have to be able to verify
it, so a SOURCE IS REQUIRED — unsourced corrections can't be merged. The more primary the source, the
faster this moves.
-->

## Substance

<!-- The name as it appears in Piru, plus any alias or brand name. -->

## What's wrong

<!--
The specific field:
- dose range (for which route?)
- onset / peak / offset duration
- half-life
- mechanism or receptor affinity
- an interaction rule
- category / other
-->

## Current value in Piru

<!-- What the app shows today. A screenshot, or Share → Markdown of the substance, is ideal. -->

## Corrected value

<!-- What it should be — with units and route. -->

## Source (required)

<!--
Primary or authoritative, with a link: a PsychonautWiki / TripSit / FreeODwiki page, a DailyMed or FDA
label, a PDSP Ki entry, a PubMed article or DOI, etc. Corrections without a checkable source are closed.
-->

## Safety relevance

<!--
Is the current value dangerously wrong — a dose an order of magnitude too high, a missing interaction
warning, a curve that reads far shorter than reality? If so, say it plainly; these get fast-tracked.
-->
